records.title: DEMAND FOR TAKING STRINGENT ACTION AGAINST MISCREANTS ATTACKING AND HARASSING NUNS WHO WERE TRAVELLING FROM DELHI TO ODISHA
details:
SHRI
MALLIKARJUN KHARGE (KARNATAKA): Sir, I wish to raise a very grave issue of attack and
harassment of two nuns who were travelling from Delhi to Odisha,
via Haridwar-Puri Kalinga
Utkal Express. They were, however, during the
journey, harassed by some activists, alleged them of conversion, they were
forcefully made to deboard at Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh. Later,
it was learnt that this was done at the behest of some complaints to Railways
that they being forced to convert their religion. Despite sharing requisite
details, the nuns were misbehaved with. They were later released after
intervention from lawyers from Delhi and these allegations having been found as
baseless. This strikes at the very root of the values of secularism, pluralism
and Fundamental Right of freedom to profess any religion, as enshrined in our
Constitution. We strongly condemn such blatant attack on the basic human rights
of the people of this country, particularly, the women and minorities. We
demand stringent action against the miscreants.
(Ends)
